items.title: Hybrid cardiac rehabilitation combining centre and home sessions: a service evaluation
items.keyFindings: A hybrid programme with two centre sessions followed by home sessions had completion similar to the centre programme it replaced.

items.title: Wearable step counters to support home-based cardiac rehabilitation: a randomised trial
items.keyFindings: Adding a step counter to home-based rehabilitation increased daily steps at 12 weeks but did not change completion.
items.limitations: Small trial; publication year not given in the reply.

items.title: Cost of remote versus centre-based cardiac rehabilitation from the health service perspective
items.keyFindings: Remote delivery cost less per enrolled patient but similar per completer once coaching time was counted.

items.title: Digital exclusion among older adults referred to cardiac rehabilitation
items.keyFindings: One in three referred adults aged 75 or over had no smartphone or reliable internet at home.

summary: Four further leads suggested for checking; none retrieved.
